title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode7 Wishes

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Normally, I'd practice somewhere closer to the station since there's usually more people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, don't rush yourself...
All you've been doing is singing by yourself in your room...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to start by getting used to singing in public.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... I can play my music through my phone's speakers...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After that event, An sent me a lot of messages.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can't sing on stage, then surpassing a legendary event...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Making An's dream come true... I can't do any of that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still nowhere near her level.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An made my heart race every time I heard her sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I had so much fun whenever we sang together. I thought anything was possible for us...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I was so happy when she started calling me her partner.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know it's probably too late now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I'd be able to come here early today since we didn't have classes...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But my committee duties ended up taking longer than expected.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last came here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even if it's from afar, I have a feeling that hearing An's voice will help motivate me more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This place... I'm still a little scared of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I never felt afraid whenever I was with An, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'll be fine...
As long as I walk off towards the side, no one should notice me...)
Huh? Hey, aren't you that girl who was always singing with An?

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line:
Hey, don't scare her like that.
Sorry, we didn't mean to startle you.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry...!
I sort of couldn't help it after I realized that you were An's partner...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line:
You two were such a great duo.
Despite having starkly different personalities, you were able to draw the best out of each other.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah, and An's been singing all by herself recently. It'd be great to see you to sing together again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They remember when we were still Vivids...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right now, I... I can't sing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want to be able to again... Someday...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: That being said... It is unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: I mean, you were An's first partner.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line:
Sorry for keeping you.
Don't stay out too late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to tell her?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want to get a lot better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want us to sing together again someday.)
